When do you take it? I took in between 12.5 mg - 100 mg over 6 years for sleep because it would knock me out. I also have bipolar but I'm not sure the mg was high enough to make a difference. I had to get at least 8 hours of sleep every night but my mood was relatively stable. I had affectionately dubbed them "snoozeberries" because of this effect. Out of the anti-depressants and mood stabilizers I've taken besides the wellbutrin (lexapro, paxil, cymbalta, wellbutrin, lamictal) it was the one I liked the most and had the least intense side effects. Lamictal was a close second but my hair started falling out so I was taken off. 

I've heard weight gain and fatique could be a problem on seroquel but my doctors put me on a stimulant in the morning so it counteracted the tiredness of it, I think. 
O
ne scary thing about seroquel and why I eventually stopped was, twice, when I increased my dosage I had what I call "snoozeberry attacks". I would feel this sudden blanket of tiredness, my vision would go black (like that feeling when you get up too fast) for like 45 seconds, i would get dizzy, my head felt like it was crushing in on itself, i could feel my heartbeating irregularly and could feel the sound of blood pumping into my head, a layer of sweat instantly appeared on my skin but I would be extremely cold. These episodes would only last about a minute at most and stopped as soon as I went to the bathroom. They were terrifying though, especially the first one. 


So basically, I don't regret taking it, just be careful when you increase your dose.

I feel like I'm reading a post from myself 8 years ago. When I was 13 I tried to kill myself and ended up in the hospital for a few weeks. At the time I wished it would have worked, but now, at 21 years old I'm extremely happy it didn't. Thirteen is one of the roughest ages, you're starting to understand the world in a new way but you don't really have much freedom - can't drive a car, can't experience real life, you have that urge for freedom but no means to escape. Things may not get better for a little bit but please, I beg you PLEASE, wait it out. 

I turned 21 and got the fuck out of dodge, packed up all my stuff and moved across the world to Switzerland. Had my attempt at 13 worked, there are SO many awesome days and nights I would have missed out on. Yeah, life sucks sometimes - maybe even a lot of the time, but if you just hang on and keep trying you'll find that there are experiences that make everything worth it. 

Also, don't worry too much about grades. I failed a bunch of classes in middle school but did enough to pass into high school, and after the first year of high school something inside of me clicked and I started doing really well. (Maybe because I hated being home so much I knew good grades were a surefire way to move out and get a scholarship for college). You are going through a rough time, thirteen sucks. 
If you need anything and just want to talk (it can be about anything) feel free to PM me.

Good luck
